label: kdpF
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the kdpF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor kdpF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,044 to 3,123 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying kdpF once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,411 calls, named 98%, 0.11 bits; shell 7,670 calls, named 71%, 0.67 bits; cloud 119 calls, named 3%, 3.18 bits. Outside an RGP 37,780 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 5,420 calls, named 70%, 0.70 bits. Columns: 61 spine, 3 fork, 16 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.70 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 96%); 5,420 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 6 (speFL, a fork column) 1.17 bits, RGP 76%; column 9 ("DUF2625 domain-containing protein", a variable column) 0.62 bits, RGP 74%; column 20 ("DeoR/GlpR family DNA-binding transcript…", a variable column) 0.47 bits, RGP 10%. The 9 columns (columns 6-9 and 39-43) where most calls are in an RGP: named 81%, 0.46 bits on average; the other 71 columns: named 94%, 0.19 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 61 spine columns: named 95%, 0.17 bits on average; the 19 fork and variable columns: named 86%, 0.38 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 6, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 6-10 (fork and variable columns), RGP 45-76%; the least: columns 67-77 (spine), RGP 2-3%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-5 (6 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-5%. Genes: kdpF "K(+)-transporting ATPase subunit F", kdpA, kdpB, kdpC, kdpD, kdpE. named 95-99.8% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 3 (kdpC), named 95%; most hesitant at column 4 (kdpD), 0.37 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 6-10 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: share 52-78%, all S, RGP 45-76%. named 56-95% (mean 83%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6, named 56%, 1.17 bits.
[S2.c6]    6 fork: speFL S 78% "leader peptide SpeFL"; also "TonB-dependent receptor" S 31%, "IS1 family transposase" S 26%
[S2.c7]    7 variable: speF S 68%
[S2.c8]    8 variable: potE S 76%
[S2.c9]    9 variable: "DUF2625 domain-containing protein" S 52%
[S2.c10]    10 variable: "lipoprotein" S 64%
[S3] 3. columns 11-19 (9 columns) spine: share 94%, all P, RGP 2-14%. Genes: pgm, seqA, ybfF "esterase", ybfE "LexA regulated protein", fldA, uof, fur, chiQ, glnS. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 19 (glnS), named 95%, 0.25 bits.
[S4] 4. column 20 variable: share 9%, all S, RGP 10%. named 87%; 0.47 bits.
[S4.c20]    20: "DeoR/GlpR family DNA-binding transcript…" S 9%
[S5] 5. columns 21-37 (17 columns) spine: share 91-94%, all P, RGP 2-23%. Genes: nagE "PTS N-acetyl glucosamine transporte…", nagB, nagA, nagC, nagD, asnB, ubiF, miaB, ybeZ "PhoH family protein", ybeY "rRNA maturation RNase YbeY", corC, lnt, gltI, gltJ "glutamate/aspartate ABC transporter…", gltK, gltL, rihA. named 76-99% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 35 (gltK), named 76%; most hesitant at column 21 (nagE), 0.35 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 38-44 (7 columns) variable: share 57-65%, all S, RGP 38-60%. named 70-87% (mean 80%), fewest named at column 43, named 70%; most hesitant at column 39, 0.45 bits.
[S6.c38-44]    columns 38-44, share 57-65%, all S: hscC 64%, djlC 62%, ybeU "DUF1266 domain-containing protein" 63%, ybeT "tetratricopeptide repeat protein" 64%, djlB 57%, ybeR "DUF1266 domain-containing protein" 64%, ybeQ "Sel1 family TPR-like repeat protein…" 65%
[S7] 7. columns 45-58 (14 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 0.4-23%. Genes: ybeL "zinc ribbon-containing protein", leuS, lptE, holA, nadD, cobC, rsfS, rlmH, mrdA "peptidoglycan DD-transpeptidase MrdA", mrdB, rlpA, dacA, ybeD "DUF493 family protein YbeD", lipB. named 85-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 45 (ybeL), named 85%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.15 bits (column 58 (lipB)).
[S8] 8. columns 59-60 (2 columns) variable: share 5-80%, all S, RGP 2-3%. named 96%; most hesitant at column 60, 0.22 bits.
[S8.c59]    59: ybeF S 80% "YbeF family transcriptional regulat…"
[S8.c60]    60: ybhH S 5% "4-oxalomesaconate tautomerase"
[S9] 9. columns 61-62 (2 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 4%. Genes: lipA, tatE. named 93%; most hesitant at column 61 (lipA), 0.26 bits.
[S10] 10. column 63 variable: share 77%, all S, RGP 3%. named 95%; 0.25 bits.
[S10.c63]    63: ybeM S 77% "deaminated glutathione amidase"
[S11] 11. columns 64-65 (2 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 3%. Genes: crcB, cspE. named 95%; most hesitant at column 65 (cspE), 0.24 bits.
[S12] 12. column 66 variable: share 90%, all P, RGP 3%. named 96%; 0.29 bits.
[S12.c66]    66: pagP P 90%
[S13] 13. columns 67-77 (11 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 2-3%. Genes: dcuC, dpiA, dpiB "sensor histidine kinase DpiB", citC, citD, citE, citF, citX "citrate lyase holo-[acyl-carrier pr…", citG, citT, rna. named 91-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 74 (citX), named 91%; most hesitant at column 77 (rna), 0.30 bits.
[S14] 14. columns 78-79 (2 columns) fork: share 57-89%, all P, RGP 2-3%. named 91%; most hesitant at column 79, 0.38 bits.
[S14.c78]    78: rnk P 89%; also ybdR S 47%, dsbG P 27%, ybdL P 11%
[S14.c79]    79: uspG P 57%; also ahpF P 41%, yldA S 23%, citR P 21%
[Q] GROUPS whose products agree, the places for a [[ ]] (name that group's columns exactly, cite its line and [Q], make one phrase from its words): columns 0-5 (kdpF to kdpE) [S1]: atpase, transporting, potassium, potassium-transporting; columns 21-25 (nagE to nagD) [S5]: glucosamine, phosphate; columns 33-36 (gltI to gltL) [S5]: aspartate, glutamate, transporter, permease; columns 70-76 (citC to citT) [S13]: citrate, lyase.
